lesson: Individually well-formed self-reported witness and terminal revision metadata does not establish batch-wide identity uniqueness. Replaying the same issuer receipt or source revision identity with a different commitment can hide contradictory cohorts or outcomes unless the batch reconciles those namespaces.
guardrail: Before any future independent verifier considers an evidence batch, compare issuer-scoped receipt IDs against frozen cohort, membership partition, protocol and witness commitments, and source-scoped revision IDs against exact decision/ticket/outcome/revision content. Permit exact idempotent duplicates, reject changed reuse, and keep all metadata-only results unverified and unscorable.
